rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose pattern for movement onto a surface.

example.english: The cat jumped onto the table.
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 tiu3 soeng5 zoeng1 toi2 laa3

rows.jyutping: zi1 dou3 A ge3 gai3 waak6
rows.note: Use this when someone has become aware of or figured out another person's plan or secret.

example.english: I finally caught onto Ming's plan—he wanted to quit.
example.traditional: 我終於知道阿明嘅計劃，原來佢想辭職。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 zi1 dou3 aa3 ming4 ge3 gai3 waak6 jyun4 loi4 keoi5 soeng2 ci4 zik1
